core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sabiha is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Beautiful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabiha corresponds to the Arabic form صَبِيحَة (Arabic root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ); صَبِيحَة (Ṣabīḥa)). Its core sense is sabiha; beautiful (feminine). Sabiha is Arabic صَبِيحَة (Ṣabīḥa) 'beautiful' (feminine), from the root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ). The source gloss 'Bringer of Glad Tidings' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as sabeeha.
